name: Psionic Lion’s Charge
body:
Discipline psychometabolism; Level gifted blade 3, psychic warrior 2

MANIFESTING

Display Mental
Manifesting Time 1 swift action

EFFECT

Range Personal
Target You
Duration 1 round
Power Points gifted blade 5, psychic warrior 3

DESCRIPTION

You gain the powerful charging ability of a lion. When you charge, you can make a full attack in the same round.

You can manifest this power with an instant thought, quickly enough to gain the benefit of the power as you charge.

Augment For every additional power point you spend, each of your attacks after a charge in the current round gains a cumulative +1 circumstance bonus on damage.
